insight: Open-sourced NeuTTS Air in Oct 2025, an Apache-2.0 748M-param TTS model that runs on CPU and clones a voice from ~3 seconds of audio.
name: Neuphonic
description: Neuphonic is a voice-AI company building text-to-speech and voice cloning that run locally with very low latency. Its cloud API targets real-time voice agents, and in October 2025 it open-sourced NeuTTS Air, a 748M-parameter speech language model that runs on CPU via llama.cpp and clones a voice from a few seconds of audio. Aimed at private, offline, and voice-agent use cases.

modelSupport.notes: Neuphonic's own voices plus the open-source NeuTTS Air model and NeuCodec.

edge: Runs realistic TTS fully on-device on a CPU — no GPU or cloud — so audio never leaves the machine.
pros: Instant voice cloning from a short sample
Very low latency for voice agents
cons: Cloud API pricing not clearly published
Open model is 748M — smaller than top cloud voices

references.title: NeuTTS Air: Open-source on-device TTS speech language model
